coordinate_convention: World wrist joint xyz + intrinsic XYZ Euler16; object xyz+wxyz. Metres/radians. Table top z=0.5.
retarget_policy: Projected Adam with original URDF finger bounds; fixed wrist and generic unbounded FK targets; 2x tip weight. This enforces joint bounds, not collision-free poses or physical holding.
episode_policy: Right-only source contact, bridging <=3-frame label gaps; up to 1 s prior reach without left contact; >=0.5 s contact; start mug bottom <=table+0.02 m. Half-open start/end.
scene_limit: Original GRAB thin tabletop approximated by its oriented bounding box; no body, head, recipient, other hand or table legs.
evaluation_limit: Subjects split before windows. Existing all44 fine-tuned checkpoints excluded; released pretrained Text2HOI GRAB checkpoint exposure is unknown, so this is adaptation holdout, not proof of unseen pretraining data.

collision.collision_algorithm: CoACD 1.0.5 compound convex decomposition, not one convex hull
collision.mass_policy: Experiment parameter, not measured GRAB mug mass
collision.geometry_limit: Convex decomposition is approximate; inspect collision_probe_audit.npz and contact behavior.

table_geometry: Per-clip captured center/yaw, 0.450015 x 0.540018 x 0.005481 m; upper plane z=0.5 m.
